description: This file defines the 'Leads' class for the vtiger CRM system, extending CRMEntity to manage lead records, including retrieval, related records, export, and relationship handling.

classes.name: Leads
classes.description: Represents the Leads module within vtiger CRM, providing methods for managing lead data, retrieving related records, exporting, permissions, and relationships.

methods.name: Leads
methods.description: Constructor for the Leads class, initializes logger, database connection, and column fields.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Generates SQL query to export lead records based on specified conditions.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves activities (tasks, events) related to a specific lead.

methods.name: get_campaigns
methods.description: Retrieves campaigns associated with a specific lead.

methods.name: get_emails
methods.description: Retrieves email records related to a specific lead.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Retrieves historical activities (completed or deferred) linked to a lead.

methods.name: get_products
methods.description: Fetches products related to a lead.

methods.name: get_lead_field_options
methods.description: Returns options for lead dropdown fields.

methods.name: getColumnNames_Lead
methods.description: Provides column labels for the lead record, used in Word plugin integration.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records from multiple leads to a target lead.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Provides secondary query parts for reporting on leads.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relationship table info for related modules.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Unlinks a lead from another entity, such as campaigns or products.

methods.name: getListButtons
methods.description: Defines buttons shown in the list view, such as delete, edit, and send mail.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Associates related records (products, campaigns, etc.) with a lead.

calls: GetRelatedList(module, related_module, other, query, button, returnset)
